notes.title: Patchnote 20200418
notes.content:
Dear players,

Thank you for your support to Blind Spot. We have fixed some identified issues in our latest patch:

[list]
[*]Fixed a missing scenery in ballroom.
[*]Fixed able to save repeatedly in the last room of chapter 3.
[*]Fixed item sometimes appear at incorrect position in theater.
[*]Fixed some collision issue.
[*]Fixed some incorrect materials.
[/list]

Also, don't forget you can set walking speed and head bobbing amount in options.

As always, we welcome your feedback.

notes.title: Blind Spot: Now Available on Steam!
notes.content:
Hello dear players:

We are very excited to announce that our puzzle adventure title Blind Spot is now available on Steam!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1267370

ABOUT THE GAME

Blind Spot is a story-driven puzzle adventure game. You wake up alone in the mansion where you have been living with your father and younger sister, but something is different from what it use to be. A text message from a mysterious number confuses you even more... Explore over 20 rooms in the mansion and solve various puzzles in order to proceed. Pay attention to every detail in your surroundings to find out what really happened. Follow your heart and decide what is the truth in the end.

The game is consist of 3 chapters and you have 4 different endings to achieve. The average play time is 5-6 hours. 

Also, you can check the VR version of Blind Spot, now 20% off:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1112360

PRICING

Blind Spot retails for $12.99, with a 10%-off first week discount.

ABOUT US


We are Unlimited Fly Games, a bunch of game enthusiasts located in Beijing, China. We hope you enjoy the game, and we are looking forward to your feedback.
